items: A license export once mis-sized a mailbox and that masked a storage problem for weeks before anyone traced it back.
Our license tool tracks seats rather than storage, so I like an export quota figure double-checked against the actual tier before it is applied.
I have seen a reconciliation run carry a stale tier mapping, so a quota change driven only by an export makes me want a quick confirmation first.
Our license reconciliation runs on an export whose tier-to-quota mapping is reviewed before the run reaches me.
Applying the standard-tier quota to a regular staff mailbox where role and tier agree is routine reconciliation work I complete without escalating.
When the export and the mailbox role line up, syncing the listed quota is just applying the agreed reconciliation figure.
